registry.title: Bounded context coverage
registry.description: Every BoundedContextEntry sourceOfTruth/edgeFunctions/tables must resolve.

registry.title: Runtime foundations
registry.description: Tier model, surfaces, capability matrix internally consistent.

registry.title: Surface ownership
registry.description: Every canonical surface owned by a team & contract.

registry.title: Policy coverage
registry.description: Sensitive routes & actions wrapped in granular permission gates.

registry.title: Policy → permission mapping
registry.description: Permission identifiers map to admin_role_permissions rows.

registry.title: Kill-switch coverage
registry.description: Every kill switch has enforcement points and runbook coverage.

registry.title: Runbook coverage
registry.description: Every kill switch / outage scenario has a referenced runbook.

registry.title: Golden path coverage
registry.description: Every critical journey has a golden-path entry & primary context.

registry.title: Meta-arch registry integrity
registry.description: Cross-references between contexts/switches/runbooks/paths resolve.

registry.title: CI umbrella integrity
registry.description: Every registered CI gate has a real script on disk.

registry.title: Feature reality coverage
registry.description: Every feature in the registry classifies all 7 surfaces honestly.

registry.title: Context membership (no orphans)
registry.description: Every route, service, edge function, table is owned by exactly one context.

registry.title: Page state coverage
registry.description: Registered pages declare the required loading/empty/error/degraded states for their class.

registry.title: CTA wiring
registry.description: Scans for placeholder onClicks, hrefs, TODOs in critical pages.

registry.title: Mock-provider leak
registry.description: No production route imports demo/mock providers.

registry.title: Deployability coverage
registry.description: Every claimed surface has build/sign/distribute/update/recover evidence.

registry.title: Edge function membership completeness
registry.description: Every supabase/functions/<name>/ on disk is claimed by exactly one bounded context.

registry.title: Table membership completeness
registry.description: Every public-schema table is claimed by exactly one bounded context.

registry.title: Page registry completeness
registry.description: Every critical page on disk is registered in page-state-registry.

registry.title: Route registry completeness
registry.description: Every <Route path=> declared in src/routes/** is owned by a bounded context.

registry.title: Ubuntu-native build pipeline (ISO + IMG + OVA)
registry.description: OS build scripts present, qemu validation green, signing artifacts wired. (iOS/Capacitor archived — see docs/PLATFORM_SCOPE.md.)

registry.title: Web deployability (13-item production SPA checklist)
registry.description: 13-item Web Deployability Checklist: zero missing, partials must have remediation, SW iframe-guarded, CSP aligned, push icons resolved.

registry.title: Desktop deployability (11-item Electron host checklist)
registry.description: 11-item Desktop Host / Electron Checklist: sandbox enforced, preload bridge matches contract (22 methods), forge signing config present, fallbacks declared for every desktop-exclusive feature.

registry.title: Appliance deployability (12-item VMware / ISO / appliance checklist)
registry.description: 12-item VMware / ISO / Appliance Checklist: ISO+OVA build pipelines real & executable, systemd units present, autoinstall configs valid, runtime-capability-matrix declares appliance column, no roadmap capability is overclaimed as native, startup-order + recovery actions wired.

registry.title: Backend / API deployability (15-item Backend / API Reality Checklist)
registry.description: 15-item Backend / API Reality Checklist: registry/membership ok, governance not RED, no active ambiguous endpoints, every active fn has auth/contract/owner, every high side-effect fn has strict rate-limit + required audit-log, every P0 frontend action has a real backend target.

registry.title: Edge function health & replay (10-item Edge Function Checklist)
registry.description: Every ORCHESTRATION_FUNCTION + CONNECTOR_WEBHOOK_FUNCTION declares a real, code-backed failure/replay path. Health adapter + admin dashboard wired and observable.

registry.title: Database / migration reality (17-item DB Reality Checklist)
registry.description: Every table has owner/writers/readers/tenancy/sensitivity. Every active edge function declares table I/O. Cross-domain writers blocked. Backup manifest fresh and restore drill green.

registry.title: Auth / policy / trust reality (Checklists 12 + 13)
registry.description: MFA + WebAuthn fully wired; resolveUnifiedPolicy invoked from ≥6 R3+ edge functions and ≥6 R3+ UI surfaces; rollback dispatch via compensation-handler-registry.

registry.title: Production operations reality (error monitoring, APM, uptime, alert routing)
registry.description: Error monitoring (Sentry + native sink) wired; ≥6 hot edge fns wrapped with withTrace; real health probes + uptime cron; alerts table live with no DEMO_ALERTS imports.

registry.title: AI / Advisor reality (Checklist 14: registry, prompts, routing, providers)
registry.description: Real DB-backed AI registries (provider/model/health/routing/prompts); advisor_registry ≥4 entries with promptFamilyId + defaultModel; R3+ capabilities reject raw inline system prompts; admin prompt explorer wired.

registry.title: Workflow & Automation reality (Checklist 16: tables, runner, repair, kill switches)
registry.description: 8 workflow/automation tables exist with RLS; workflow-execute, workflow-repair, workflow-stuck-detector, workflow-replay deployed; admin page queries real workflow_runs (no DEMO_RUNS); KS-WORKFLOW + KS-AUTOMATIONS enforced in execute and dispatch.

registry.title: No workflow bypass (only canonical runner writes workflow_runs)
registry.description: Direct insert into workflow_runs is forbidden outside workflow-execute / workflow-repair / workflow-replay / workflow-stuck-detector edge functions.

registry.title: Domain OS reality (Checklist 17: 5 core domains × 10 checks)
registry.description: 5 core domains (business-os, finance-os, concierge-os, investment-office, boardroom) each have a manifest, a row in domain_ownership_registry, all manifest dbTables in the live schema, a canonical routes file, an e2e spec, at least one edge fn, and (for boardroom) a proof-writing edge fn.

registry.title: Owner workflow reality (Checklist 18: every workflow entry + step mounted)
registry.description: Every OwnerWorkflow entry and steps[].route must resolve to a mounted admin route (real page, alias redirect, or registry redirect). All 5 workflow keys (daily, weekly, support, release, trust-safety) must be present with ≥4 steps each, and every workflow domain must appear in ADMIN_DOMAINS.

registry.title: Manifest theater elimination (Checklist 20: bidirectional registry ↔ disk)
registry.description: Bidirectional truth: every generated/*.json on disk must be registered in MANIFEST_REGISTRY, every registry entry must point to a real file on disk, and every authoritative entry must have an existing validator script. Eliminates manifest theater (orphans + phantoms).

registry.title: Onboarding components folder (canonical primitives + consumer adoption)
registry.description: Asserts src/components/onboarding/ exists with ≥ 5 primitive .tsx files + index.ts barrel, and that ≥ 5 ceremony screens under src/pages/revenue-office/onboarding/screens/ import from @/components/onboarding. Drift-prevents the audit-flagged P2 (folder does not exist; UI lives entirely under pages/).

registry.title: Artifact index traceability (producer ↔ artifact ↔ consuming-gate)
registry.description: Asserts generated/INDEX.json exists, is schema-valid (v1), has ≥90% traceability coverage, every producer path is on disk (or a known external source like .github/, supabase/functions/, package.json), and public/generated/INDEX.json is byte-identical (sha256 parity). Drift-prevents the audit-flagged P1 (external validators cannot trace any artifact back to its producer-script or downstream consuming-gate without parsing the heavyweight 913-entry ownership manifest).

registry.title: Final "It's Real" Gate (Checklist 27: 13-clause aggregator)
registry.description: Aggregates the 13 upstream truth reports (feature reality, route completeness, edge function membership+health, db reality, table membership, auth/policy/trust, mobile store+build, owner workflows, manifest theater, runbook operability, kill switches, golden paths, test+release truth, observability truth, mock leak) into a single verdict. Emits verdict="real" only when all 13 clauses are green. Last gate in the launch pipeline.

registry.title: Edge function ownership completeness (per-function manifest, 100% coverage)
registry.description: Asserts every supabase/functions/<name>/index.ts on disk has an owner team, primaryContact, escalationContact, slackChannel, and reviewerCodeOwners in EDGE_FUNCTION_OWNER_MAP / EDGE_FUNCTION_OWNERSHIP_MANIFEST. Asserts no phantom entries, mirror parity (generated/ ↔ public/generated/), and freshness ≤ 7 days. Drives the canonical machine-readable ownership manifest at generated/edge-function-ownership.json and the public mirror used by external probes.
